slash.name: lsp
slash.description: code navigation (poly-lsp): the language servers; definitions, uses and renames
slash.help:
Code navigation (poly-lsp) lets the model find where a name is defined and where it is used, read a function by its name, and rename it across files. It uses each language's own server (gopls, tsserver, pylsp) where one is installed.
/lsp alone — a table of the languages and their language servers, each on or off at the global, project or session scope
/lsp on|off|unset <language> [--global|--project|--session] — one language's server (off: its tree-sitter index only); the code server restarts
/lsp add <name> --ext .x --cmd <server> [--arg A] [--off-by-default] [--format-on-edit] — a language server of your own (poly-lsp-mcp lsp add); /lsp remove <name> takes it back
/lsp on, /lsp off — the code server itself, for this session; /lsp auto, /lsp manual — for every session of this project
/lsp exclude <dir> — leave a directory out of the index, for this project (dun does this itself when the index does not fit its startup budget, and says so); /lsp include <dir> puts it back
/lsp budget <Nms|Nops|0|default> — the index's startup budget, for this project
/lsp status — whether it is on, its index, and what it leaves out
